Self-Sewing Thread.name: Self-Sewing Thread
Self-Sewing Thread.description: You can use this thread to clear either a Hit Point or 2 Armor Slots.

Slayer's Salt.name: Slayer's Salt
Slayer's Salt.description: You can spread this salt in a line along windowsills or thresholds to create a magical barrier that undead creatures can't cross until the line is broken.

Snakeskin Spirit.name: Snakeskin Spirit
Snakeskin Spirit.description: You can drink this potion to slough off your outer layer of skin and heal a scar.

Snapthorn Seed.name: Snapthorn Seed
Snapthorn Seed.description: You can throw this seed at a point you can see. It explodes into a tangle of binding vines that temporarily Restrains all creatures within Close range of that point.

Sprite Bottle.name: Sprite Bottle
Sprite Bottle.description: When you mark your last Hit Point, this bottle shatters to release the Sprite inside. The Sprite clears all your Hit Points before fading from the Mortal Realm.

Staff of Reversal.name: Staff of Reversal
Staff of Reversal.description: You can break this staff against the ground to reverse one magical transformation or effect within Far range.

Stake of Abjuration.name: Stake of Abjuration
Stake of Abjuration.description: You can hammer this stake into the ground and make a proclamation. Until your next rest, a creature within Far range of the stake who transgresses that proclamation must mark a Stress. The stake lasts until your next rest, then it shatters.

Steelskin Salve.name: Steelskin Salve
Steelskin Salve.description: You can apply this salve to your skin to gain a bonus to your damage thresholds equal to your tier until the end of the scene.

Stonemason's Fortune.name: Stonemason's Fortune
Stonemason's Fortune.description: When you throw this gray brick on the ground, it immediately grows into a 6-foot-tall, 10-foot-wide, and 2-foot-deep wall of solid stone.

Sunlight Orb.name: Sunlight Orb
Sunlight Orb.description: You can shatter this orb to make the area within Very Far range appear as though it's sunlit daytime for the next 24 hours.

Tears of the Undying Hero.name: Tears of the Undying Hero
Tears of the Undying Hero.description: When you drink this potion, death can't touch you until your next long rest. When you would mark your last Hit Point, instead of making a death move, you make one final action roll before falling into a dreamless slumber until an ally chooses the Tend to Wounds downtime move to clear your Hit Points.

Warding Candle.name: Warding Candle
Warding Candle.description: You can light this candle to fill an area within Close range with a halo of light. A creature outside the halo can't enter it if they have ill intent toward a creature within it. The candle burns for an hour.
